features.name: MIDI Device Enumeration
features.note: 7/7 control coverage. List input/output devices respond identically (output shows 'Microsoft GS Wavetable Synth'); auto-detect toggle is a matched no-op with no hardware (2/3 actions live in both apps). Layout, headers and red status banner match the UWP golden.

features.name: Receive MIDI Messages
features.note: 2/2 control coverage. INPUT DEVICES ('No MIDI ports found') and RECEIVED MESSAGES sections render identically to the UWP golden. No actionable controls without hardware.

features.name: Send MIDI Messages
features.note: Structural 4/8: parameter1/2/3 combos and sysExMessageContent are Visibility=Collapsed by default in BOTH the UWP source and migrated app (verified identical XAML), revealed only after selecting a message type (requires MIDI hardware). Reset/Send are non-responsive in the WinUI app AND in the UWP golden (hardware-gated), so no behavioral regression. Scored partial because the deeper send-message path could not be exercised without hardware; the visible state (OUTPUT DEVICES with 'Microsoft GS Wavetable Synth', SEND MESSAGE header, Message Type combo) matches the UWP golden.
